Autodesk.AutoCAD.ApplicationServices.Doc.summaryEn: This function provides a way for an application to determine if it could have permission to set a lock on a document. One rule about locking is that an execution context can override any of its own locks. If this application's context has an Exclusive Write lock, it can still apply another lock to the document. Returns the highest level lock set by other execution contexts if bIncludeMyLocks == false. If bIncludeMyLocks == true, then the function will return the highest level lock set by any execution context, include this application.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.EditorInput.Editor.Turn.summary: 此函数将使 AutoCAD 输入事件机制在所有数字化器事件下进行拾取，无论是否获取点或任何 OSNAP 模式当前是否激活。
Autodesk.AutoCAD.EditorInput.Editor.Turn.summaryEn: This function will cause the AutoCAD input event mechanism to do a pick under the prevailing pick aperture on all digitizer events, regardless of whether a point is being acquired or whether any OSNAP modes are currently active.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.EditorInput.Editor.Turn.summary: 此函数递减强制拾取计数器，如果计数器达到 0，则禁用强制拾取，这意味着实体拾取在正常的 AutoCAD 条件下发生，例如当获取输入点且 OSNAP 模式激活时，或进行正常的实体选择操作。
Autodesk.AutoCAD.EditorInput.Editor.Turn.summaryEn: This function decrements the forced pick counter, and if the counter hits 0, disables forced picking, which means entity picking occurs under normal AutoCAD conditions, such as when input points are being acquired and an OSNAP mode is active, or normal entity selection operations.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.EditorInput.Editor.Turn.summary: 使用此函数增加一个引用计数器，当非零时，会导致任何形式的窗口选择（如 acedSSGet() 中的 _W 和 _WP），与嵌套实体信息请求（如使用 acedSSGet() 中的 “:n” 模式）相结合，如果主实体的一个或多个子实体完全包含在窗口内，则选择主实体。
Autodesk.AutoCAD.EditorInput.Editor.Turn.summaryEn: Using this function increments a reference counter which, when non-zero, causes any form of a window selection (such as _W and _WP in acedSSGet()), coupled with a request of nested entity information (such as using the ":n" mode in acedSSGet()), to select the main entity if one or more of the main entity's subentities is fully contained within the window.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.EditorInput.Editor.Turn.summary: 使用此函数递减一个引用计数器，当为零时，关闭子实体窗口选择。当子实体窗口选择启用时，任何形式的窗口选择（如 acedSSGet() 中的 _W 和 _WP），与嵌套实体信息请求（如 acedSSGet() 中的 “:n” 模式）相结合，如果主实体的一个或多个子实体完全包含在窗口内，则选择主实体。
Autodesk.AutoCAD.EditorInput.Editor.Turn.summaryEn: Using this function decrements a reference counter which, when zero, turns off subentity window selection.When subentity window selection is enabled, any form of a window selection (such as _W and _WP in acedSSGet()), coupled with a request of nested entity information (such as the ":n" mode in acedSSGet()), selects the main entity if one or more of the main entity's subentities is fully contained within the window.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Action.summary: AcDbActionsToEvaluateCallback 包装器。此回调由 AssocAction::getDependentActionsToEvaluate() 方法使用，以通知其他动作、依赖项或任意对象，它们也应该被评估，因为它们依赖于要评估的给定动作。
Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Action.summaryEn: AcDbActionsToEvaluateCallback Wrapper This callback is used by AssocAction::getDependentActionsToEvaluate() method to inform about other actions, dependencies or arbitrary objects that should also be evaluated because they depend on the given action that is to be evaluated.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Action.summary: 此回调方法由 AssocAction::getDependentActionsToEvaluate() 调用。它是 getDependentActionsToEvaluate() 通知 AssocAction、AssocDependency 或 DBObject 需要评估并建议它们的新状态的机制。如果给定的 ObjectId 不是动作或依赖项，而是任意 DBObject，则回调实现应简单地递归调用 needsToEvaluate() 以评估该对象的所有依赖项。此回调不需要客户端代码实现。关联框架评估机制提供了一个默认实现，它在计算所有需要评估的动作的传递闭包时使用。
Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Action.summaryEn: This callback method is called by AssocAction::getDependentActionsToEvaluate(). It is a mechanism by which getDependentActionsToEvaluate() informs that an AssocAction, AssocDependency, or an DBObject needs to be evaluated and suggests new status for them that the callback implementation should set. If the given ObjectId is not of an action or of a dependency, but of an arbitrary DBObject, the callback implementation should simply recursively call needsToEvaluate() for all dependencies on that object. This callback does not need to be implemented by the client code. The Associative Framework evaluation mechanism provides a default implementation that it uses when calculating a transitive closure of all actions that need to be evaluated.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.AssocD.summary: 设置依赖的 AssocStatus。如果状态是表示拥有依赖的操作需要评估的状态之一（对于此类状态，IsEvaluationRequest() 断言返回 true），则还可以通知拥有依赖的操作更改其状态，以指示它需要评估。操作可能会更改其状态并通知拥有该操作的网络。网络可能会更改其状态并通知其拥有网络等，直到层次结构中的所有网络都通知它们包含需要评估的操作。如果新状态满足 IsEvaluationRequest() 断言，并且新状态的 EvaluationRequestSeverityLevel() 低于依赖当前评估请求状态，则保留依赖的当前更高状态，而不是用新状态覆盖。此外，如果依赖的当前状态满足 IsToBeSkipped() 断言，则不会被任何 IsEvaluationRequest() 的新状态覆盖。在这种情况下更改依赖状态时，需要首先将依赖状态更改为 IsUpToDateAssocStatus，然后才能将其更改为 IsEvaluationRequest() 状态。
Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.AssocD.summaryEn: Sets the AssocStatus of the dependency. If the status is one of the codes that indicate that the action owning the dependency will need to be evaluated (the IsEvaluationRequest() predicate returns true for such a status), it can also notify the action owning the dependency to change its status indicating that it needs to be evaluated. The action may change its status and notify the network owning the action. The network may change its status and notify its owning network, etc. until all the networks in the hierarchy are notified that they contain an action that needs to be evaluated. If the new status satisfies the IsEvaluationRequest() predicate and EvaluationRequestSeverityLevel() of the new status is lower than the current evaluation request status of the dependency, the current higher status of the dependency is kept and not overwritten by the new lower status. Also, if the current status of the dependency satisfies the IsToBeSkipped() predicate, it is not overwritten by any new status that IsEvaluationRequest(). To change the dependency status in such a case, the dependency status needs to be first changed to IsUpToDateAssocStatus, and after that it can be changed to an IsEvaluationRequest() status.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.AssocN.summary: 添加一个关联动作，使其由该网络拥有。要添加的动作不得由任何网络拥有。除了最顶层的关联网络之外，每个动作都“逻辑上”由单个关联网络拥有。网络成为动作的“逻辑”所有者。它也可能成为动作的“物理”数据库所有者（网络具有动作的硬所有权标识符），但“物理”所有者可能是其他对象。例如，对于附加到块表记录的网络，逻辑所有者是整个数据库的顶级网络，但物理数据库所有者是 AcBdBlockTableRecord 扩展字典的子字典。
Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.AssocN.summaryEn: Adds an AssocAction to be owned by this network. The action being added must not be owned by any network. Every action except for the topmost AssocNetwork is "logically" owned by a single AssocNetwork. The network becomes the "logical" owner of the action. It may also become the "physical" database owner of the action (the network has hard-ownership id of the action), but the "physical" owner may be some other object. For example, for networks attached to BlockTableRecords, the "logical" owner is the top-level network of the whole database but the "physical" database owner is the subdictionary of the extension dictionary of the AcBdBlockTableRecord.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.AssocN.summary: 从网络中移除关联动作，并可选择将其删除。要移除的动作必须由该网络拥有。
Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.AssocN.summaryEn: Removes an AssocAction from the network and optionally erases it. The action being removed must be owned by this network.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.AssocN.summary: 将给定的关联动作添加到由该网络拥有的动作中。要添加的动作不得由任何网络拥有。网络成为动作的“逻辑”所有者。它也可能成为动作的“物理”数据库所有者（网络具有动作的硬所有权标识符），但“物理”所有者可能是其他对象。例如，对于附加到块表记录的网络，逻辑所有者是整个数据库的顶级网络，但物理数据库所有者是块表记录扩展字典的子字典。
Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.AssocN.summaryEn: Adds the given AssocActions to be owned by this network. The actions being added must not be owned by any network. The network becomes the "logical" owner of the action. It may also become the "physical" database owner of the actions (the network has hard-ownership id of the actions), but the "physical" owner may be some other object. For example, for networks attached to BlockTableRecords, the "logical" owner is the top-level network of the whole database but the "physical" database owner is the subdictionary of the extension dictionary of the BlockTableRecord.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.AssocA.summary: 包装 AcDbAssocAction::actionBody() 方法。
Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.AssocA.summaryEn: This wraps the AcDbAssocAction::actionBody() method.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.AssocA.summary: 设置动作的关联状态。如果状态指示动作需要评估（IsEvaluationRequest() 返回 true 的状态），但动作的当前状态不是需要评估，则将此状态传播到拥有该动作的关联网络，并在网络层次结构中更高，直到拥有此网络的网络等，以便所有拥有网络都知道它们包含需要评估的动作。如果新状态的 IsEvaluationRequest() 和 EvaluationRequestSeverityLevel() 低于动作当前评估请求状态，则保留动作的当前更高状态，而不是用新状态覆盖。此外，如果动作的当前状态 IsToBeSkipped()，则不会被任何 IsEvaluationRequest() 的新状态覆盖。在这种情况下更改动作状态，需要首先将动作状态更改为 IsUpToDateAssocStatus，然后才能将其更改为 IsEvaluationRequest() 状态。
Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.AssocA.summaryEn: Sets the AssocStatus of the action. If the status is one of the codes that indicate that the action will need to be evaluated (the IsEvaluationRequest() predicate returns true for such a status), but the current status of the action is not that it would need to be evaluated, it propagates this status up to the AssocNetwork owning the action, and higher in the network hierarchy to the network owning this network, etc, so that all owning networks know that they contain an action that needs to be evaluated. If the new status IsEvaluationRequest() and EvaluationRequestSeverityLevel() of the new status is lower than the current evaluation request status of the action, the current higher status of the action is kept and not overwritten by the new lower status. Also, if the current status of the action IsToBeSkipped(), it is not overwritten by any new status that IsEvaluationRequest(). To change the action status in such a case, the action status needs to be first changed to IsUpToDateAssocStatus, and after that it can be changed to an IsEvaluationRequest() status.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.AssocA.summary: 除了最顶层的关联网络之外，每个动作在逻辑上由单个关联网络拥有。此网络也可以是动作的“物理”数据库所有者（网络具有动作的硬所有权标识符），但“物理”所有者也可以是其他对象。例如，对于附加到 BlockTableRecords 的网络，逻辑所有者是整个数据库的顶级网络，但“物理”数据库所有者是 AcBdBlockTableRecord 扩展字典的子字典。不应直接调用此方法，应使用 AssocNetwork.AddAction 和 AssocNetwork.RemoveAction()，它们反过来调用 setOwningNetwork()。
Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.AssocA.summaryEn: Every action except for the topmost AssocNetwork is logically owned by a single AssocNetwork. This network may also be the "physical" database owner of the action (the network has hard-ownership id of the action), but the "physical" owner may also be some other object. For example, for networks attached to BlockTableRecords, the "logical" owner is the top-level network of the whole database but the "physical" database owner is the subdictionary of the extension dictionary of the AcBdBlockTableRecord. This method should not be called directly, AssocNetwork.AddAction and AssocNetwork.RemoveAction() should be used, which in turn calls setOwningNetwork().

Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.AssocA.summary: 获取此动作的关联依赖项。默认实现获取基动作类拥有的所有依赖项，并根据所需的读写类型选择它们。如果动作拥有一个覆盖 getDependenciesOverride() 方法的关联动作体对象，则调用此方法，并取代默认实现。它允许自定义动作体类控制要返回哪些依赖项以及不返回哪些依赖项。
Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.AssocA.summaryEn: Gets AssocDependencies of this action. The default implementation obtains all dependencies owned by the base action class and selects the ones based on the required read/write type. If the action owns an AssocActionBody object that overrides the getDependenciesOverride() method, this method is called and it supersedes the default implementation. It allows the custom action body classes to control which dependencies to return and which not to mention.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.AssocA.summary: 将给定的关联依赖项添加到此动作。依赖项可以是此动作的所有者（如果 setThisActionAsOwningAction 为 true），这是最常见的情况，或者只是被此动作引用。
Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.AssocA.summaryEn: Adds the given AssocDependency to this action. The dependency may either become owned by this action (if setThisActionAsOwningAction is true) which is the most common case, or just referenced by this action.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.AssocA.summary: 从此动作中删除给定的关联依赖项。
Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.AssocA.summaryEn: Removes the given AssocDependency from this action.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.AssocA.summary: 从此动作的依赖项向量中删除所有关联依赖项，并可选地删除它们。如果动作拥有一个覆盖 RemoveAllDependenciesOverride() 方法的关联动作体对象，则调用此方法以通知正在删除依赖项。这发生在所有依赖项都已删除之后。
Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.AssocA.summaryEn: Removes all AssocDependencies kept in the vector of dependencies of this action and optionally also erases them. If the action owns an AssocActionBody object that overrides the RemoveAllDependenciesOverride() method, this method is called to notify about the dependencies being removed. This happens after all the dependencies have already been removed.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.AssocA.summary: 获取此动作所依赖或修改的对象。默认实现收集动作具有关联依赖项的所有对象。如果动作拥有一个覆盖 GetDependentObjectsOverride() 方法的关联动作体对象，则调用此方法并取代默认实现。它允许自定义动作体类控制要返回哪些对象以及不返回哪些对象，但通常不需要覆盖此方法，遍历动作所有依赖项的默认实现应该足够。
Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.AssocA.summaryEn: Gets objects that this action depends on or modifies. The default implementation collects all objects on which the action has AssocDependencies. If the action owns an AssocActionBody object that overrides the GetDependentObjectsOverride() method, this method is called and it supersedes the default implementation. It allows the custom action body classes to control which objects to return and which not to mention, but usually there is no need to override this method, the default implementation that traverses all the dependencies of the action should suffice.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.AssocA.summary: 检查给定的关联依赖项是否为此动作的所有者，无论是直接所有，还是如果此动作是网络，则是由网络拥有的动作的所有者。
Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.AssocA.summaryEn: Checks whether the given AssocDependency is owned by this action, either directly, or if this action is a network, is owned by an action owned by the network.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.AssocA.summary: 检查由此动作拥有的关联依赖项是否对此动作外部，即它依赖于不是此动作且不是此动作所有者（当动作是网络时）的 DBObject。
Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.AssocA.summaryEn: Checks whether the given AssocDependency, owned by this action, is external to this action, i.e., it depends on an DBObject that is not this action and is not owned by this action (when the action is a network).

Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Databa.summary: 此函数遍历数据库模型空间中的所有实体，并更新数据库模型空间的 EXTMAX 和 EXTMIN 变量到遍历期间确定的值。将参数 doBestFit 设置为 TRUE 意味着在遍历数据库时，任何找到的 BlockReference 实体应调用 geomExtentsBestFit() 方法而不是 geomExtents() 方法。这将较慢但会生成更紧凑的边界框（范围）。使用默认参数 FALSE 将更快但可能不会生成最紧凑的边界框。
Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Databa.summaryEn: This function iterates through all the entities in the database's Model Space and updates the database's Model Space extents variables EXTMAX and EXTMIN to the values determined during the iteration. Setting the argument doBestFit to TRUE means that while traversing the database, any BlockReference entities found should have their geomExtentsBestFit() method called instead of geomExtents(). This will be slower but will generate a tighter bounding box (extents). Using the default argument of FALSE will be faster but may not produce the tightest bounding box.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Databa.summaryEn: Returns the objectId of the object that has the handle value contained in objHandle. If createIfNotFound is true and the handle is not found in the database, then a new objectId stub object is created using the handle sought. Use of the createIfNotFound argument is intended for AutoCAD internal use only (there is no way for an ObjectARX program to do anything with a objectId stub object that is not associated with any database object), so ObjectARX programs should always set this argument to false.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Databa.summary: 将指定的文件名读取到执行此函数的数据库对象中。文件名必须包含文件扩展名（即使文件扩展名不是 .dwg）。文件名可能是一个URL。此函数使用“懒加载”机制，这意味着只有在需要时才会读取图纸的某些部分。因此，图纸文件将保持打开状态，直到数据库对象被删除，此时数据库析构函数将关闭图纸文件。它始终尝试以读取访问权限打开文件。如果没有读取访问权限，则失败。模式描述了当同一文件已被打开时，其他应用程序如何访问该文件。allowCPConversion参数控制当用户尝试读取一个NLS文件不可用，无法将图纸的代码页转换为系统代码页的dwg文件时的行为（例如，在英文操作系统上的日本图纸）。如果allowCPConversion为false，AutoCAD将弹出一个对话框解释情况并询问用户是否允许某种默认转换，这可能会导致数据丢失。如果allowCPConversion为true，文件将打开并且转换将静默进行。如果密码为NULL，如果需要密码并且密码缓存中没有适用密码，则提示用户输入密码。警告：此函数应仅用于使用其构造函数的buildDefaultDrawing参数设置为false创建的新数据库。如果在此方法上使用buildDefaultDrawing设置为true的数据库，或者数据库中已有信息（包括之前对此函数的调用等原因），则会导致内存泄漏，甚至更糟。
Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Databa.summaryEn: Reads the drawing file specified by fileName into the database object executing this function. fileName must include the extension of the file (which does not have to be .dwg) if the file to open has one, even if the extension is .dwg. fileName may be a URL. This function uses the "lazy-load" mechanism, which means that pieces of the drawing are read in only as needed. So, the drawing file is left open until the database object is deleted, at which point the database destructor closes the drawing file. It always tries to open files with read access. It fails if read access is not available. The mode describes how other applications may access the file when the same file has already been opened. The allowCPConversion argument controls the behavior when the user tries to read a dwg file where the NLS files are not available to convert from the codepage of the drawing to the codepage of the system (for example, a Japanese drawing on an English OS). If allowCPConversion is false, AutoCAD will pop up a dialog explaining the situation and asking if the user wants to allow some kind of default conversion, which might cause a data loss. If allowCPConversion is true, the file will be opened and the conversion will happen silently. If password is NULL, the user is prompted for a password if one is required and if no applicable password exists in the password cache. Warning This function should only be used on a newly created Database that was created with its constructor's buildDefaultDrawing argument set to false. If this method is used on an Database that was created with buildDefaultDrawing set to true, or an Database that already has information in it (for any reason including a previous call to this function), then memory leaks, or worse, will result.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Databa.summary: 如果与此数据库关联了图纸文件，则此函数强制立即从文件中读取所有必要信息到数据库对象中，并断开文件与数据库的连接。如果closeFile为true，则在文件被完全读取到并从数据库中断开连接后，将关闭图纸文件。如果closeFile为false，则仍然会从数据库中断开图纸文件的连接，但图纸文件将保持打开状态，直到主机应用程序会话结束。此函数在每个数据库上只执行一次，因此第一次调用后的多次调用将没有效果。建议为此参数传递true。如果与此数据库关联了图纸文件，则此函数强制立即从文件中读取所有必要信息到数据库对象中。如果closeFile为true，则在文件被完全读取到数据库后，将关闭图纸文件。
Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Databa.summaryEn: If a drawing file is associated with this Database, then this function forces an immediate read of all necessary information from the file into the Database object and disconnects the file from the Database. If closeFile is true, the drawing file will be closed when it has been fully read into, and disconnected from, the Database. If closeFile is false, the drawing file will still be disconnected from the Database, but the drawing file will remain open until the host application session ends. This function will only execute once per Database, so multiple calls will have no effect after the first call. Passing true for this argument is recommended. If a drawing file is associated with this database, then this function forces an immediate read of all necessary information from the file into the database object. If closeFile is true, the drawing file will be closed when it has been fully read into the Database.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Databa.summary: 此函数解决工作数据库中现有的xrefs。如果useThreadEngine为true，并且没有其他因素禁用它，则使用多线程引擎解决xrefs。如果doNewOnly为true，则仅处理未解决的xref记录。忽略现有的已解决xref LayerTableRecords、LinetypeTableRecords和BlockTableRecords。在这种情况下，useThreadEngine参数也被忽略，并且不使用多线程引擎。警告：此函数不执行文档锁定；调用者负责锁定文档。此功能适用于非AutoCAD基于的主机应用程序。
Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Databa.summaryEn: This function resolves existing xrefs in the working database. If useThreadEngine is true, and other factors haven't disabled it, then the multi-thread engine is used for resolving the xrefs. If doNewOnly is true, only unresolved xref records are processed. Existing resolved xref LayerTableRecords, LinetypeTableRecords, and BlockTableRecords are ignored. In this case, the useThreadEngine argument also is ignored, and the multi-thread engine is not used. Warning No document locking is done by this function; the caller is responsible for locking the document. This function is available to non-AutoCAD-based host applications.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Entity.summaryEn: This method sets entity to reference the LayerTableRecord identified by the name specified in newValue. For an BlockReference entity, this method will also update any associated SequenceEnd subentity. Note The only built-in entities for which kTrue has an effect are: 2dPolyline, 3dPolyline, PolyFaceMesh, and PolygonMesh. The database containing the entity is searched for the LayerTableRecord object with the name pointed to by newValue. If the entity is not currently in a database, then the database currently in the AutoCAD editor is searched. Specifying true for allowHidden allows newValue to denote a hidden layer. If this parameter is false (default) and newValue denotes a hidden layer the change request is silently ignored.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Databa.summary: 此函数模拟AutoCAD INSERT命令。首先在执行此函数的数据库中创建一个新的块表记录。新块表记录被赋予由blockName指向的名称。然后，将dataBase指向的数据库中的所有模型空间实体复制到新的块表记录中。preserveSourceDatabase参数确定是否保留源数据库dataBase的完整性。参数的默认值为true。在这种情况下，源数据库的对象被复制到目标数据库，而源数据库保持不变。如果调用者为此参数传递false，则源数据库的对象可能被物理移动到目标数据库。后者运行更快，但会使源数据库依赖于目标数据库。调用者应确保在删除目标数据库之前立即或至少在删除目标数据库之前删除源数据库。返回由此函数创建的新块表记录的对象ID。
Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Databa.summaryEn: This function creates a new block table record in the database executing this function. This new block table record is given the name pointed to by destinationBlockName. Then, each entity in the block table record whose name is sourceBlockName and which resides in the database pointed to by dataBase is copied into the new block table record. The preserveSourceDatabase argument determines whether the source database dataBase is left intact. The default value of the argument is true. In that case, objects from the source database are copied to the destination database, and the source database is not changed. If the caller passes false for this argument, objects from the source database could be physically moved into the destination database. The latter runs faster, but it leaves the source database dependent on the destination database. The caller should make sure that the source database is deleted either immediately, or at least before the destination database is deleted. Returns the object ID for the new block table record created by this function.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Databa.summary: 克隆objectId数组中的所有对象，并将它们追加到由owner指定的容器对象中。mapping填充了包含原始和克隆对象对objectId实体的IdMapping对象。此数组可用于对深拷贝操作中涉及的对象进行后处理。当新对象被分配所有者时，布局对象触发一个断言，断言所有者是目标数据库的布局字典，并且布局在字典中有一个与布局内部存储的名称匹配的名称。（字典拥有的对象的默认行为将是给它一个匿名名称，如“A1”。）
Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Databa.summaryEn: Clones all objects in the objectId array and appends them to the container object specified by owner. mapping is filled with IdMapping objects that contain the objectId entities of the original and cloned object pairs. This array can be used for post-processing the objects involved in the deepClone operation. When the new objects are assigned owners, layout objects trigger an assert that the owner is the destination database's layout dictionary and the layout is given a name in the dictionary that matches the name stored inside the layout. (The default behavior for dictionary-owned objects would be to give it an anonymous name like "*A1".).

Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Entity.summary: 此方法设置实体的状态，以指示实体在关闭时是否应更新屏幕上的显示。如果实体设置为不更新，则任何更改将在实体下次重新生成时显示。如果 setModified 为 false 且实体当前设置为在关闭时更新其图形（这是其默认状态），则此函数将实体设置为在关闭时不在屏幕上更新，并将对象修改通知发送到所有附加到实体的实体类型反应器。如果 setModified 为 true，则实体在关闭时设置为在屏幕上更新。
Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Entity.summaryEn: This method sets the entity's state to indicate whether or not the entity should be updated on screen when it is closed. If the entity is set not to update, then any changes made will appear the next time the entity is regenerated. If setModified is false and the entity is currently set to update its graphics on close (which is its default state), then this function sets the entity so that it will not update on screen when it is closed and objectModified notification is sent to all entity type reactors attached to the entity. If setModified is true, then the entity is set to update on screen when it is closed.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Entity.summary: 此函数将实体的图形排队并刷新图形队列，强制实体和队列中的任何其他内容在屏幕上绘制或重新绘制。

Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Entity.summary: 函数使用：此函数突出显示屏幕上的整个实体。
Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Entity.summaryEn: Function usage This function uses the FullSubentityPath ID to determine which subentity in the entity is desired. It then highlights that subentity on screen. If no FullSubentityPath argument is provided, then the entire entity will be highlighted. Typically, the FullSubentityPath object passed in via subId is obtained from the entity's Entity.GetSubentPathsAtGraphicsMarker() method. This guarantees that it is fully and properly filled in. This function uses the entity's GetGraphicsMarkersAtSubentPath() method to get the GS markers associated with subId. It is not necessary to balance each Highlight() function call with a corresponding call to Unhighlight(). Calling the Unhighlight() function will unhighlight the entity designated by subId regardless of how many times the highlight function has been called on it. Warning If the entity on which this method is called has its graphics queued for regeneration (that is, changes have been made to the entity but have not yet been reflected on screen), then this method will not cause a highlight to occur. Also, calling this method on an entity that's open for write and whose graphics are queued for regeneration may terminate AutoCAD. To avoid this limitation, before calling highlight(), you should flush the entity's graphics by either calling the entity's draw() method, or calling the TransactionManager.FlushGraphics() function. Function implementation in derived classes The Entity.Highlight() implementation does all the work necessary to highlight any subentities that correspond to the subId. So, there is no need to override this method unless you wish to do some pre-or post-processing, or you wish to disable the ability to highlight subentities. If this method is overridden and it is supposed to highlight subentities, then the Entity.Highlight() method will need to be invoked at some point within this function in order to do the actual highlighting. Within the Entity.Highlight() method, the GetGraphicsMarkersAtSubentPath() method of this entity is called to translate the FullSubentityPath into the corresponding GS markers. So, if this function is to succeed, the GetGraphicsMarkersAtSubentPath() method needs to be implemented as well. For more information on the subId argument, see the documentation on the GetGraphicsMarkersAtSubentPath() or GetSubentPathsAtGraphicsMarker() methods.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Entity.summary: 函数使用：此取消突出显示屏幕上的整个实体。
Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Entity.summaryEn: Function usage This function uses the FullSubentityPath id to determine which subentity in the entity is desired. It then unhighlights that subentity on screen. If no FullSubentityPathargument is provided, then the entire entity will be unhighlighted. Typically the FullSubentityPath object passed in via subId will be obtained from the entity's Entity.GetSubentPathsAtGraphicsMarker() method. This guarantees that it is fully and properly filled in. This function uses the entity's GetGsMarkersAtSubentPath() method to get the GS markers associated with subId. It is not necessary to balance each Highlight() function call with a corresponding call to Unhighlight(). Calling the Unhighlight() function will unhighlight the entity designated by subId regardless of how many times the highlight function has been called on it. Function implementation in derived classes The Entity.Unhighlight() implementation does all the work necessary to unhighlight any subentities that correspond to the subIdFullSubentPath. So, there is no need to override this method unless you wish to do some pre-or post processing, or you wish to disable the ability to unhighlight subentities. If this method is overridden and it is supposed to unhighlight subentities, then the DBEntity.Unhighlight() method needs to be invoked at some point within this function in order to do the actual unhighlighting. Within the Entity.Unhighlight() method, the GetGraphicsMarkersAtSubentPath() method of this entity is called to translate the FullSubentityPath into the corresponding GS markers. So, if this function is to succeed, the GetGraphicsMarkersAtSubentPath() method needs to be implemented as well. For more information on the subId argument, see the documentation on the Entity.GetGraphicsMarkersAtSubentPath() or Entity.GetSubentPathsAtGraphicsMarker() methods.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Hatch..summaryEn: This function evaluates the hatch lines or solid fill for the hatch entity using the specified hatch pattern. For regular hatch patterns, except for solid, this function performs intersection calculations between pattern definition lines and hatch boundary curves to form hatch lines. For a solid fill hatch pattern, this function performs triangulation of the hatch area and fills in the triangular meshes with the given color. Note Be sure to call SetHatchPattern() before using this method in order to update the display.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Linety.summary: 设置 LinetypeTableRecord 中位置 index 处的形状（或文本字符串）的 UcsOriented 位（位 1）。如果 IsUcsOriented 为 true，则设置位并使形状在显示时相对于当前 UCS 定位。如果 IsUcsOriented 为 false，则形状将相对于其嵌入的线进行定位。index 必须大于或等于零，但小于 NumDashes 返回的值。index 是基于零的索引（形状和文本字符串的索引与在类型定义中它们之前的前导虚线的索引相同），类型中的第一个虚线是索引 0。有关类型定义和嵌入形状的更多信息，请参阅 AutoCAD 自定义指南中的“线型”部分。
Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Linety.summaryEn: This function sets the UcsOriented bit (bit 1) for the shape (or text string) at position index in the LinetypeTableRecord. If IsUcsOriented is true, then the bit is set and the shape will orient itself relative to the current UCS when displayed. If IsUcsOriented is false, then the shape will orient itself relative to the line it's embedded within. index must be greater than or equal to zero, but less than the value returned from NumDashes. index is a zero-based index (shapes and text strings have the same index as the dash that precedes them in the linetype definition) with the first dash in the linetype being index 0. For more information on linetype definitions and embedded shapes, see the "Linetypes" section of the AutoCAD Customization Guide.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Mline..summaryEn: In this function, givenPoint is projected along the normal vector onto the plane containing the MLine object. Then the resulting projected point is used to find the point on the MLine object that is closest. pointOnCurve is filled in with the closest point found. Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.OpenCl.summary: obj 必须指向一个新创建的对象（即，它从未被关闭过）并且已经是数据库驻留的（即，它已被添加到数据库中，因此有一个 objectId）。如果 add 为 true，则 obj 指向的对象被添加到顶级事务中。如果 add 为 false，则对象从它所在的任何事务中移除。
Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.OpenCl.summaryEn: obj must point to an object that is newly created (that is, it has never been closed) and is already database resident (that is, it's been added to an Database so it has an objectId). If add == true, the object pointed to by obj is added to the top transaction. If add == false, then the object is removed from whatever transaction it's within.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.PlotSe.summary: 确定布局是否使用 StdScaleType 属性来计算当前绘图比例。UseStandardScale 属性指示是否使用 StdScaleType 属性来计算绘图比例。如果为 true，CustomPrintScale 属性反映与 StdScaleType 对应的计算比例。如果为 false，CustomPrintScale 属性和 StdScaleType 属性无关，并且只有 CustomPrintScale 属性有效。换句话说，CustomPrintScale 属性始终反映用于绘图的当前比例，无论它是基于标准比例计算还是用户直接指定的。UseStandardScale 属性指示 CustomPrintScale 的获取方式（从标准比例计算，包括缩放适应，或用户直接指定）。StdScaleType 属性始终具有值，但仅在 UseStandardScale 属性为 true 时用于计算 CustomPrintScale。
Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.PlotSe.summaryEn: Determines whether the layout will use the StdScaleType property to calculate the current plot scale. The UseStandardScale property indicates whether the StdScaleType property is used to compute the scale of the plot. If true, the CustomPrintScale property reflects the computed scale corresponding to the StdScaleType. If false, the CustomPrintScale property and the StdScaleType properties are unrelated, and only the CustomPrintScale property is valid. In other words, the CustomPrintScale property always reflects the current scale used to plot, regardless of whether it was computed based on a standard scale or was specified directly by the user. The UseStandardScale property indicates how the CustomPrintScale was obtained (by calculating it from a standard scale, including scale-to-fit, or by the user specifying it directly). The StdScaleType property always has a value, but is only used to compute the CustomPrintScale when the UseStandardScale property is true.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Raster.summary: 原始图像尺寸，以像素为单位。（图像尺寸也可以直接从 RasterImageDef 对象中获取。）在特定罕见条件下，缓存值将暂时与 RasterImageDef 对象中保持的值不同（例如，在图像尺寸被光栅编辑操作更改后但光栅图像实体缓存更新之前）。如果 bGetCachedValue 为 false（默认值），则图像尺寸请求将转发到关联的 RasterImageDef 对象。如果该对象无法打开，则使用本地缓存值。如果 bGetCachedValue 为 true，则函数将强制返回缓存值。
Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Raster.summaryEn: the raw image size in pixels. (The image size is also available directly from the RasterImageDef object.) Under certain rare conditions the cached value will temporarily be different from the value kept in the RasterImageDef object (for example, immediately after the image size has been changed by a raster edit operation but before the RasterImage entity cache is updated). If bGetCachedValue is false (default), the image size request is forwarded to the associated RasterImageDef object. If that object can't be opened, then a locally cached value is used. If bGetCachedValue is true, the function is forced to return the cached value.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Polyli.summaryEn: If true, the polyline displays its linetype across vertices.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Polyli.summary: 获取多段线是否应该闭合（即从最后一个顶点到第一个顶点绘制一个段）或不应闭合。
Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Polyli.summaryEn: Accesses whether the polyline should be closed (that is, there is a segment drawn from the last vertex to the first) or not.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Polyli.summary: 从指向实体所指向的Polyline2d的数据填充多段线。实体必须指向数据库中SimplePoly或FitCurvePoly类型的Polyline2d对象。此函数应从尚未存在于数据库中的Polyline调用。如果transferId为true，调用Polyline将成为数据库驻留。调用Polyline将假定Polyline2d实体的ObjectId、句柄以及任何扩展实体数据（除了顶点上的数据）、扩展字典和反应器。然后实体将被删除并设置为NULL。如果transferId为false，实体将保持数据库中的状态，调用者必须关闭它。结果的多段线将不会是数据库驻留的，如果没有附加到数据库，则应该被删除。
Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Polyli.summaryEn: This fills the Polyline with data from the Polyline2d pointed to by entity. entity must point to a SimplePoly or FitCurvePoly type of Polyline2d object in a database. This function should be called from an Polyline that is not yet database-resident. If transferId is true, the calling Polyline will become database-resident. The calling Polyline will assume the ObjectId and handle, plus any extended entity data (except data on vertices), the extension dictionary, and reactors of the Polyline2d entity entity. entity will then be deleted and set to NULL. If transferId is false, entity will remain in the database as is and the caller must close it. The resulting Polyline will not be database-resident, and if not appended to a database, should be deleted.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Polyli.summary: 此函数从多段线创建Polyline2d并返回新创建的Polyline2d。如果transferId为true，新创建的Polyline2d将成为数据库驻留，并假定Polyline的ObjectId、句柄以及任何扩展实体数据、扩展字典和反应器。然后Polyline将不再驻留数据库，并且可以通过C++的delete运算符删除。如果transferId为false，则Polyline将保持数据库中的状态，调用者必须关闭它。结果的多段线和所有顶点将不会是数据库驻留的，如果没有附加到数据库，则应该被删除。
Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Polyli.summaryEn: This function creates an Polyline2d from the Polyline and returns the newly created Polyline2d. If transferId is true, the newly-created Polyline2d will become database-resident and will assume the ObjectId and handle, plus any extended entity data, extension dictionary, and reactors of the Polyline on which this method is called. The Polyline will then no longer be database-resident and can be deleted by the C++ delete operator. If transferId is false, then the Polyline will remain in the database as is and the caller must close it. The resulting Polyline2d and all its vertices will not be database-resident, and if not appended to a database, should be deleted.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Polyli.summary: 此函数返回世界坐标系中顶点索引的3D位置。
Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Polyli.summaryEn: This function returns the 3D location of the vertex index in World Coordinates.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Polyli.summaryEn: This function returns the type of segment (SegType) that is headed by the vertex index.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Polyli.summary: 如果顶点索引处的段是直线，则此函数返回多段线自己的对象坐标系（OCS）中该段的代表2D副本。
Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Polyli.summaryEn: If the segment at vertex index is a line, then this functions returns a representative 2D copy of that segment in the polyline's own object coordinate system (OCS).

Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Polyli.summary: 如果顶点索引处的段是圆弧，则此函数将从多段线中填充圆弧的2D圆弧信息（半径、中心等）到多段线自己的OCS中。
Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Polyli.summaryEn: If the segment at vertex index is an arc, then this function will fill in arc with the 2D arc information (radius, center, and so on) from the polyline in the polyline's own OCS.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Polyli.summary: 如果顶点索引处的段是直线，则此函数返回该段在世界坐标系中的代表3D副本。
Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Polyli.summaryEn: If the segment at vertex index is a line, then this functions returns a representative 3D copy of that segment in World Coordinates.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Raster.summary: 立即从Image Engine的工作内存中卸载RasImageDef中的图像数据，但不删除RasImageDef本身。触发通知，导致所有依赖的RasterImage实体仅以框架形式重绘。需要RasterImageDef处于可写状态。如果modifyDatabase为true，则对RasterImageDef对象所做的更改将进行撤销记录。
Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Raster.summaryEn: Immediately unloads the image data in RasImageDef from the Image Engine's working memory, but does not delete the RasImageDef itself. Triggers notification that causes all dependent RasterImage entities are redrawn as frames only. Requires that the RasterImageDef be open for writing. If modifyDatabase is true, then undo recording will be done for the changes made to the RasterImageDef object.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Raster.summary: 当此对象下次关闭时，导致当前图纸中所有依赖此对象的RasterImage实体被重绘。
Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Raster.summaryEn: Causes all the RasterImage entities in the current drawing that are dependent upon this object to be redrawn when this object is next closed.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Raster.summary: 创建图像数据的副本，并返回对其的指针。注意：由于ATIL Engine除非或直到原始图像或副本被修改，否则不会创建图像的物理副本，因此此函数可用于高效地只读访问源图像数据。
Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Raster.summaryEn: Creates a copy of the image data, and returns a pointer to it. Note Since the ATIL Engine doesn't make a physical copy of the image unless or until the original or the copy is modified, this function can be used for efficient read-only access to the source image data.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Raster.summary: 返回用于写入的关联图像数据对象。

Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Raster.summary: 关闭关联的图像数据对象，并更新AutoCAD中图像实例的任何更改。
Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Raster.summaryEn: Closes the associated image data object, and updates any changes to the image instances in AutoCAD.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Raster.summary: 直接指定用于的内存中Atil.Image或自定义Atil.FileReadDescriptor。图像或fileDescription可以null，但不能同时为null。Atil.Image和Atil.FileReadDescriptor的副本由RasterImageDef保留，因此调用者的这些对象的副本可以在任何时候被删除。此功能旨在供光栅编辑应用程序开发者使用。当调用此函数时，Loaded状态必须为false。它可以用来构建RasterImageDef对象而不是调用ActiveFileName。如果image不为null且有效，则“loaded”状态设置为true。否则，“loaded”状态设置为false。如果image为null，则fileDescription必须是一个有效的可读或写Atil.FileReadDescriptor，可以从其中按需读取图像。如果fileDescription不为null且有效，则从其中提取分辨率和文件类型信息。如果fileDescription具有有效的文件路径，则它用作“active path”。否则，“active path”设置为空字符串。如果modifyDatabase为true，则对RasterImageDef对象所做的更改将进行撤销记录。使用ImageModified和RasterImageDefReactor机制来通知尝试删除此图像。否则，用户可能能够通过用户界面卸载或重新加载图像，可能会丢失尚未保存到磁盘的图像数据。
Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Raster.summaryEn: Directly specifies an in-memory Atil.Image or a custom Atil.FileReadDescriptor to be used. Either image or fileDescription can be null, but not both. Copies of the Atil.Image and Atil.FileReadDescriptor are retained by the RasterImageDef, so the caller's copy of these objects may be deleted at any time. This function is intended for use by raster editing application developers. The Loaded status must be false when this function is called. It can be used to construct an RasterImageDef object in lieu of calling ActiveFileName. If image is not null and is valid, the "loaded" status is set true. Otherwise, "loaded" status is set to false. If image is null, then fileDescription must be a valid read or write Atil.FileReadDescriptor from which an image can be read on demand. If fileDescription is not null and is valid, resolution and file type information is extracted from it. If fileDescription has a valid file path, it is used as the "active path." Otherwise, "active path" is set to the null string. If modifyDatabase is true, undo recording will be done for changes made to the RasterImageDef object. Use ImageModified and the RasterImageDefReactor mechanism to be notified of attempts to delete this image. Otherwise, the user may be able to Unload or Reload the image through the user interface, possibly losing image data that hasn't been saved to disk.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Spline.summaryEn: This .NET method wraps the ObjectARX method. Generates a polyline to approximate a spline without using PLINETYPE and PLINECONVERTMODE. The resulting curve could be an Polyline or an 3dPolyline. If the spline is not planar, then the result will always be an AcDb3dPolyline and will always have line segments. If the spline is planar, then if bConvertAsArcs is truen, the resulting polyline will be arc segments, otherwise it will be line segments. And, if the spline is planar and bToLWPolyline is true, then the result will be an AcDbPolyline, otherwise it will be an AcDb2dPolyline.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Spline.summaryEn: This .NET method wraps the ObjectARX method. Generates a polyline to approximate a spline without using PLINETYPE and PLINECONVERTMODE. The resulting curve could be an AcDbPolyline, an AcDb2dPolyline, or an AcDb3dPolyline. If the spline is not planar, then the result will always be an AcDb3dPolyline and will always have line segments. If the spline is planar, then if bConvertAsArcs is truen, the resulting polyline will be arc segments, otherwise it will be line segments. And, if the spline is planar and bToLWPolyline is true, then the result will be an AcDbPolyline, otherwise it will be an AcDb2dPolyline.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Table..summary: 此函数更新表格对象引用的块表记录，以匹配自上次块表记录更新以来对表格对象所做的任何更改。如果 forceUpdate 为 true，则无论表格对象自上次块表记录更新以来是否已更改，都将更新块表记录。如果 forceUpdate 为 false，则只有当表格对象自打开以来已更改、当前未擦除且未处于撤销操作中时，才会更新块表记录。
Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Table..summaryEn: This function updates the block table record the table object references to match any changes made to the table object since the last time the block table record was updated. If forceUpdate is true, then the block table record will be updated regardless of whether or not the table object has had any changes since the last time the block table record was updated. If forceUpdate is false, then the block table record will only be updated if the table object has been changed since it was opened, is not currently erased, and is not in the middle of an undo operation.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Table..summary: 此方法允许用户在更改一个或多个属性时暂时禁用表格对象的重新生成。警告：此方法是为 VBA 应用程序提供的，用于暂时禁用表格对象的重新生成。它不适用于 ObjectARX 应用程序。将此函数的 suppress 参数设置为 true 将禁用表格对象的重新生成。当此函数的 suppress 参数设置为 false 时，将重新计算表格对象。在将表格对象保存到绘图文件之前，用户应调用此函数并设置 false 值或调用 RecomputeTableBlock(true)。否则，表格对象将不会显示。
Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Table..summaryEn: This method allows the user to temporarily disable the regeneration of the table object during changes in one or more of its properties. Warning This method is provided for VBA applications to temporarily disable the regenerating of the table object. It is not intended for use in ObjectARX applications. Calling this function with suppress set to true disables regenerating the table object. The table object is recomputed when this function is called with suppress set to false. Before saving the table object to the drawing file, the user should either call this function with false value or call RecomputeTableBlock(true). Otherwise, the table object will never be displayed.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Symbol.summaryEn: This method returns a "repaired" copy of the specified string. The method uses the same symbol name validation rules as the validation functions (such as validatePreExtendedSymbolname() and validateSymbolName()) except that the returned copy of the string does not contain any illegal characters. Those are replaced with valid replacement characters.

If add == true, the object pointed to by obj is added to the top transaction. If add == false, then the object is removed from whatever transaction it's within.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.Runtime.DynamicLinker.L.summary: 加载fileName ObjectARX程序。fileName是操作系统注册表中设置的程序名称。如果ObjectARX应用程序在注册表中没有条目，或者注册表条目设置了AcadApp.LoadDisabled加载原因，或者reasons中的任何LoadReasons与应用程序注册表条目中的LoadReasons不匹配，则此函数将无法加载应用程序。如果printIt为true，则将消息发送到AutoCAD文本屏幕，指示加载操作的成功或失败。当asCmd为True时，加载只能发生一次。第二次尝试加载将返回False。在这种情况下，不会增加应用程序的引用计数。当asCmd为False时，可以多次调用此方法并仍然获得成功的返回值。当您要加载的.arx文件已经加载时，此方法将简单地增加应用程序的引用计数。
Autodesk.AutoCAD.Runtime.DynamicLinker.L.summaryEn: Loads the fileName ObjectARX program. fileName is the application name as set in the operating system registry. If the ObjectARX application does not have an entry in the registry, or if the registry entry has the AcadApp.LoadDisabled load reason set, or if any of the the LoadReasons in reasons do not match the LoadReasons in the application's registry entry, then this function will be unable to load the application. If printIt is true, then a message is sent to the AutoCAD text screen indicating the success or failure of the load operation. When asCmd is True, loading can happen only once. A second attempt to load will return False. The reference count for the application is not increased in this case. When asCmd is False, it's possible to call this method more than once and still get a successful return value. When the .arx you want to load is already loaded, this method will simply increment the reference count for the application.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.GraphicsSystem.View.Get.summary: 将 pixelArea 的 X 坐标设置为 WCS 单位正方形垂直轴上的像素数，将 pixelArea 的 Y 坐标设置为单位正方形水平轴上的像素数。在透视模式下，WCS 单位正方形随着远离相机而变小，包含的像素变少；而在非透视模式下，单位正方形的大小保持不变，无论距离相机多远。因此，如果视图中启用了透视模式，则给定世界点用作单位正方形的中心，以便将相机到点的距离反映在像素值中。如果未启用透视模式，则不使用给定世界点，因为位置对像素计数没有影响。此函数通常用于确定几何图形何时将显示为接近像素大小。在这些情况下，为了速度和内存效率，几何图形可能以更简单的形式显示，而观众无法察觉任何差异。

Autodesk.AutoCAD.Runtime.DynamicLinker.U.summary: 卸载 fileName ObjectARX 程序。fileName 是操作系统注册表中设置的程序名称。如果 ObjectARX 应用程序未通过 DynamicLinker.loadApp() 方法或通过按需加载机制（所有这些都使用应用程序的系统注册条目）加载，则此函数将无法卸载应用程序。当 asCmd 为 False 时，可以多次调用此方法并获得成功的返回值。此方法将简单地减少应用程序的引用计数。
Autodesk.AutoCAD.Runtime.DynamicLinker.U.summaryEn: Unloads the fileName ObjectARX program. fileName is the application name as set in the operating system registry. If the ObjectARX application was not loaded via the DynamicLinker.loadApp() method or through the demand loading mechanism (all of which use the system registry entry for the application), then this function will be unable to unload the application. When asCmd is False, it's possible to call this method more than once and still get a successful return value. This method will simply decrement the reference count for the application.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.Runtime.DynamicLinker.I.summary: 如果模块成功找到并加载，则返回 true；否则，返回 false。
Autodesk.AutoCAD.Runtime.DynamicLinker.I.summaryEn: Returns true if the module is successfully found and loaded; otherwise, returns false.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.Runtime.DynamicLinker.L.summary: 加载 appName ObjectARX 程序。appName 是操作系统注册表中设置的程序名称。如果 ObjectARX 应用程序在注册表中没有条目，或者注册表条目设置了 AcadApp.LoadDisabled 加载原因，或者 reasons 中的任何 LoadReasons 与应用程序注册表条目中的 LoadReasons 不匹配，则此函数将无法加载应用程序。如果 printIt 为 true，则将消息发送到 AutoCAD 文本屏幕，指示加载操作的成功或失败。当 asCmd 为 True 时，加载只能发生一次。第二次尝试加载将返回 kFalse。在这种情况下，不会增加应用程序的引用计数。当 asCmd 为 False 时，可以多次调用此方法并获得成功的返回值。当您要加载的 .arx 已加载时，此方法将简单地增加应用程序的引用计数。
Autodesk.AutoCAD.Runtime.DynamicLinker.L.summaryEn: Loads the appName ObjectARX program. appName is the application name as set in the operating system registry. If the ObjectARX application does not have an entry in the registry, or if the registry entry has the AcadApp.LoadDisabled load reason set, or if any of the the LoadReasons in reasons do not match the LoadReasons in the application's registry entry, then this function will be unable to load the application. If printIt is true, then a message is sent to the AutoCAD text screen indicating the success or failure of the load operation. When asCmd is True, loading can happen only once. A second attempt to load will return kFalse. The reference count for the application is not increased in this case. When asCmd is False, it's possible to call this method more than once and still get a successful return value. When the .arx you want to load is already loaded, this method will simply increment the reference count for the application.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.Runtime.DynamicLinker.U.summary: 卸载 appName ObjectARX 程序。appName 是操作系统注册表中设置的程序名称。如果 ObjectARX 应用程序未通过 DynamicLinker.LoadApp() 方法或通过按需加载机制（所有这些都使用应用程序的系统注册条目）加载，则此函数将无法卸载应用程序。当 asCmd 为 False 时，可以多次调用此方法并获得成功的返回值。此方法将简单地减少应用程序的引用计数。
Autodesk.AutoCAD.Runtime.DynamicLinker.U.summaryEn: Unloads the appName ObjectARX program. appName is the application name as set in the operating system registry. If the ObjectARX application was not loaded via the DynamicLinker.LoadApp() method or through the demand loading mechanism (all of which use the system registry entry for the application), then this function will be unable to unload the application. When asCmd is False, it's possible to call this method more than once and still get a successful return value. This method will simply decrement the reference count for the application.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.GraphicsInterface.Geome.summary: edgeData 指向一个包含边缘的颜色、图层、可见性、线型和选择标记设置的 EdgeData 对象。指向的 EdgeData 对象中的每个数组必须为 NULL 或必须具有 (row - 1) x column + row x (column -1) 个元素。faceData 指向一个包含颜色、图层、可见性、线型和选择标记设置的 FaceData 对象。指向的 FaceData 对象中的每个数组必须为 NULL 或必须具有 (row -1) x (column - 1) 个元素。vertexData 指向一个包含表示顶点在面上的方向的标志和指向顶点法线数组的 VertexData 对象。顶点法线数组必须为 NULL 或必须具有 row x column 个元素。注意，const 说明符表示，不更改或删除参数数组或对象。调用者负责其使用的内存。此函数使用作为参数传递的各种对象生成和显示网格原语。
Autodesk.AutoCAD.GraphicsInterface.Geome.summaryEn: edgeData points to an EdgeData object that contains arrays of color, layer, visibility, line type, and selection marker settings for the edges. Each of the arrays in the EdgeData object pointed to must either be NULL or must have (row - 1) x column + row x (column -1) elements. faceData points to an FaceData object that contains arrays of color, layer, visibility, line type, and selection marker settings for the faces. Each of the arrays in the FaceData object pointed to must either be NULL or must have (row -1) x (column - 1) elements. vertexData points to an existing VertexData object that contains a flag indicating vertex orientation on faces and a pointer to an array of vertex normals. The array of vertex normals must either be NULL or must have row x column elements. Note as the const qualifiers indicate, does not change or delete the parameter array or objects. The caller is responsible for the memory they use. This function uses the various objects passed in as parameters to generate and display a mesh primitive.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.GraphicsInterface.Geome.summary: edgeData 指向一个包含边缘的颜色、图层、可见性、线型和选择标记设置的 EdgeData 对象。指向的 EdgeData 对象中的每个数组必须为 NULL 或必须具有与边缘数量相同的元素数量。faceData 指向一个包含颜色、图层、可见性、线型和选择标记设置的 FaceData 对象。指向的 FaceData 对象中的每个数组必须为 NULL 或必须具有与面数量相同的元素数量。vertexData 指向一个包含表示顶点在面上的方向的标志和指向顶点法线数组的 VertexData 对象。顶点法线数组必须为 NULL 或必须具有 nbVertex 个元素。在 worldDraw 期间，填充实体（以及常规填充图案）使用壳原语。当进行 SAVEASR12 操作时，worldDraw 例程使用 ResBuf 参数将扩展实体数据附加到 Solid 实体，以便在从旧填充转换为新填充的过程中重建原始填充。对于正常使用，此参数应设置为 NULL。注意，const 说明符表示，不更改或删除参数数组或对象。调用者负责其使用的内存。此函数使用作为参数传递的各种对象生成和显示壳原语。壳的几何形状基于一组用于创建面的顶点。最小化，必须指定顶点列表以及使用顶点创建面的列表。面可以与其他面共享顶点（然而，下面的示例没有显示这一点）。使用壳而不是网格的优点是网格不能有孔，不能有不相交的区域，并且不能有 n 边面。壳可以具有所有这些。边缘、面和顶点数据是可选参数，但如果有面数据，则必须指定边缘数据。如果有顶点数据，则必须指定边缘和面数据。如果需要，使用 NULL 作为未使用的参数。面列表 faces 定义了面及其可能包含的孔。在面列表中，面由一组数字定义。第一个数字必须是面的顶点数，接下来的数字必须是组成面的顶点的索引；如果面是孔，则其顶点数必须输入为负数。面中的任何孔必须紧跟在包含面的定义之后。孔必须共面且完全在面内（不接触边缘），否则结果不可预测。边缘是通过按照面列表中列出的顺序绕面行走来确定的。例如，如果面列表包含 3, 0, 1, 2，这将定义一个具有 3 个顶点的面：顶点 0、顶点 1 和顶点 2，并且具有从顶点 0 到 1、顶点 1 到 2 和顶点 2 到 0 的边缘。在壳的边缘数据列表中，边缘按顺序从面（或孔）到面（或孔）列出，正如它们在面列表中按顺序排列。壳面数据排序与面列表中的排序相同，但省略了任何孔。警告：如果壳面有 5 个或更多边缘或它有任何孔，您将丢失可能已应用于壳的任何边缘、面或顶点数据。当壳被发送出来进行显示时，它将被分成三角形，这很慢。返回值假（即 0）表示原语已成功存储在图形数据库中。返回值真表示操作已终止，并且应用程序希望尽快获得控制权。
Autodesk.AutoCAD.GraphicsInterface.Geome.summaryEn: edgeData points to an EdgeData object that contains arrays of color, layer, visibility, line type, and selection marker settings for the edges. Each of the arrays in the EdgeData object pointed to must either be NULL or must have the same number of elements as the number of edges. faceData points to an FaceData object that contains arrays of color, layer, visibility, line type, and selection marker settings for the faces. Each of the arrays in the FaceData object pointed to must either be NULL or must have the same number of elements as the number of faces. vertexData points to an VertexData object that contains a flag indicating vertex orientation on faces and a pointer to an array of vertex normals. The array of vertex normals must either be NULL or must have nbVertex elements. The hatch solid (and regular hatch pattern) use the shell primitive during worldDraw. When a SAVEASR12 operation is in progress, the worldDraw routine uses the ResBuf parameter to attach extended entity data onto the Solid entity so that the original solid hatch can be reconstructed during a conversion from old to new hatches. For normal usage, this parameter should be set to NULL. Note as the const qualifiers indicate, does not change or delete the parameter array or objects. The caller is responsible for the memory they use. This function uses the various objects passed in as parameters to generate and display a shell primitive. A shell's geometry is based on a set of vertices that are used to make faces (and holes in faces). Minimally, a list of vertices must be specified and a list of how the faces are made using the vertices. Faces may share vertices with other faces (however, the example given below does not show this). The advantage in using a shell instead of a mesh is that a mesh cannot have holes, cannot have disjoint regions, and cannot have faces that are n-sided. The shell can have all of these. The edge, face, and vertex data are optional parameters, but if you have face data, you must specify edge data. If you have vertex data, you must specify edge and face data. Use NULL for unused parameters if they are required. The face list faces defines the faces and any holes that might be in them. In a face list, a face is defined by a set of numbers. The first number must be the number of vertices in the face, the following numbers must be the indices of the vertices making up the face; if the face is a hole, then its number of vertices must be entered as negative. Any holes in a face must immediately follow the definition of the containing face. A hole must be coplanar and completely inside a face (not touching an edge), otherwise, the results are unpredictable. An edge is determined by walking around the face in the order listed in the face list. For example, if the face list contained 3, 0, 1, 2, this would define a face having 3 vertices: vertex 0, vertex 1, and vertex 2., and which has edges from vertex 0 to 1, vertex 1 to 2, and vertex 2 to 0. In an edge data list for a shell, the edges are listed sequentially from face (or hole) to face (or hole) as they are ordered in the face list. The ordering of shell face data is the same order as in the face list but omitting any holes. Warning You will lose any edge, face, or vertex data that you may have applied to the shell if a shell face has 5 or more edges or if it has any holes. As the shell is being sent out for display, it will be divided into triangles, which is slow. A return value of false (that is, 0) indicates that the primitive has been successfully stored in the graphics database. A return value of true indicates that the operation has been terminated and the application wants to get control back as soon as possible.

Autodesk.AutoCAD.GraphicsInterface.Geome.summary: 此方法在生成文本图形原语时使用当前 TextStyle。
Autodesk.AutoCAD.GraphicsInterface.Geome.summaryEn: This function uses an TextStyle object to determine the font, size, etc. to use for the text. The position, normal, and direction can be thought of as the foundation for a coordinate system that orients the text in 3D world space, where the position is the origin, the direction is the X axis, and the normal is the Z axis. A copy of the text string is used in message, so the calling application is responsible for the memory of the string passed in. A length value of -1 indicates that message is null terminated. A value greater than 0 indicates the length in bytes of message. A raw value of true indicates that the AutoCAD escape codes {%%U, %%d, %%P, and %%nnn} should not be interpreted. A return value of false (that is, 0) indicates that the primitive has been successfully stored in the graphics database. A return value of true indicates that the operation has been terminated and the application wants to get control back as soon as possible.
